subject: INTEGER-OF-DATE function
notes: The format asserts one argument and two required words, and each assertion is now measured in both directions. Arity: the one-argument form throughout l1_integer_date_form_returned, and l1-integer-of-date-arity2 rejecting a second argument at all four editions (COBOL1504) — §15.46 being a COBOL-85 function, no lower edition rejects the name first. Required word: l1-integer-of-date-no-function-word omits FUNCTION with no REPOSITORY paragraph (COBOL1543, reject-at 2002+ because KeywordOmittedFunction returns null below 2002 and §8.4.3.2.3 SR2's permission arrives with §12.3.8 at COBOL-2002), and l1_repository_bare_intrinsic_names supplies the permission's ACCEPTING arm under FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC — so KeywordOmittedFunction, which this code-location names, is exercised from both sides rather than cited and never reached.
